mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Pirate Hunter</titleLeft><mainText>Yarr! I'm a mighty Pirate... hunter!</mainText>

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Miss Fortune has increased <speed>Movement Speed</speed> until she is hit in combat.

mLocKeys.keySummary: After 5 seconds of not being attacked, Miss Fortune gains an additional <speed>25 Movement Speed</speed>. This bonus increases by 9 each second up to a maximum bonus of 70.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Miss Fortune has increased <speed>Movement Speed</speed> until she is hit in combat.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune channels a flurry of bullets into a cone in front of her, dealing large amounts of damage to enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Miss Fortune channels a barrage of bullets into a cone in front of her for 2 seconds, dealing <physicalDamage>@PhysicalDamagePerWave@ physical damage</physicalDamage> per bullet (<physicalDamage>Total Damage: @TotalDamage@</physicalDamage>).

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune fires a bullet at an enemy, damaging them and a target behind them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Miss Fortune fires a shot at an enemy target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <physicalDamage>@TotalRicochetDamage@ physical damage</physicalDamage> to another enemy target behind the first. Applies on-hit effects.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune unleashes a flurry of bullets at a location, dealing waves of damage to opponents and slowing them.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Miss Fortune fires hundreds of bullets into the air that rain down at a location after 0.5 seconds, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamagePerSecond@ magic damage</magicDamage> over 2 seconds and <status>Slowing</status> enemies hit by @TotalSlowAmount@ for 1 second.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Impure Shots (Active) </titleLeft><mainText>Miss Fortune has increased <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> and lowers <healing>Healing</healing> and <keyword>Regeneration</keyword> received by all targets she hits by 50%.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Miss Fortune passively increases damage dealt to a target with each strike.  This ability can be activated to increase Miss Fortune's Attack Speed and cause her attacks to lower healing received by the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive: Miss Fortune deals @TotalDamageOnHIt@ magic damage to her target with each attack, cumulatively stacking up to @MaxStacks@ times on the same target.
Maximum bonus damage: @MaximumTotalDamageOnHit@

Active: Miss Fortune's Attack Speed is increased by @ASMod@% for 6 seconds and causes her attacks to apply 50% Grievous Wounds for 3 seconds.
